pulls.title: Editorial review: inclusive language, copy-paste fix, clarity improvements
pulls.author: cpignata
pulls.body:
## Summary

- Replace colloquialism "apples-to-apples" with "direct, reproducible comparison" per NIST IR 8366 inclusive language guidance
- Fix copy-paste error in Collective Communication Library Bus Bandwidth Summary table (was incorrectly showing the UET spray efficacy template; now correctly shows BusBW per collective operation, accelerator count, and load balancing strategy)
- Normalize ASCII art box widths in Topology A for consistent rendering across HTML/PDF
- Clarify AlltoAll description: "every other participating accelerator" (removes ambiguity)
- Add `{{UEC-1.0}}` citation for the 1 million endpoint scalability claim in PDC Scalability section

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify rendered HTML output of Topology A ASCII art looks correct
- [ ] Confirm CCL BusBW Summary table structure matches intent of the section
- [ ] Review inclusive language changes against NIST IR 8366
